agentId.description: DID of the agent being credentialed (subject). Example: did:key:z6Mk...

subjectId.description: DID of the underlying real-world subject (organization, user) the agent acts on behalf of. Optional but recommended for KYA traceability.

controllerId.description: DID of the controller who can revoke this credential. Typically the issuer's operations key.

orgId.description: Organization identifier (free-form, e.g. company registration number, LEI). Used in cross-credential reconciliation.

roles.description: Roles assigned to this agent. Each role implies a baseline scope set; explicit scopes below override.

scopes.description: Fine-grained capability scopes (e.g. 'payments:send', 'data:read:financial'). Optional override over roles.

permissions.description: Boolean permission map for binary capabilities. MVP supports a fixed set; custom permissions are V2.

can_settle_x402.description: Authorize the agent to settle x402 micropayments.

can_request_attestation.description: Authorize the agent to request a Lemma attestation bundle (product C).

can_issue_subordinate.description: Authorize the agent to issue subordinate agent credentials.

can_sign_in.description: Authorize the agent to perform ZK Proof Sign-in (product D).

can_invoke_inference.description: Authorize the agent to invoke proof-anchored inference (product B).

amount.description: Maximum spend within window. String to preserve precision (USDC has 6 decimals).

currency.description: Settlement currency. MVP supports USDC only on Base mainnet. USDT/EURC are planned for V2 — passing them returns INVALID_CURRENCY in MVP.

spendLimit.description: Financial guard rail enforced at attestation-verification time by consuming services.

paymentPolicy.description: How the agent's payments are funded. MVP supports prepaid only. 'postpaid' and 'subscription' are V2 — passing them returns POLICY_NOT_SUPPORTED in MVP.

issuedAt.description: Issuance timestamp. If omitted, Lemma uses server time.

expiresAt.description: Expiration timestamp. Maximum 1 year from issuance per MVP policy.

sourceSystem.description: Free-form identifier of the system that originated the issuance (e.g. 'aws-bedrock-agentcore', 'custom-pipeline-v2'). Stored for provenance only.

rpcUrl.description: Optional RPC endpoint reference for verifier reconciliation.
